title: Gradient fill renders wrong: solid on stage, non-smooth in Ruffle
description:
RESOLVED (task 1198). PlayButton linear-gradient face: solid on stage + non-smooth in Ruffle.

ROOT CAUSE per layer:
(1) IMPORT (flash8-binary.ts): CORRECT, no change needed. The 3 stops 0(#00CCFF)/253(#009AFF)/255(#0099FF) and matrix {a:0,b:0.0244140625,c:-0.0750732421875,d:0,tx:0.05,ty:6} match golden.swf's published gradient EXACTLY (golden MATRIX decodes to identical floats; the FLA binary stores the gradient matrix in the same 16.16 units as SWF, and readMatrix already /65536). The 'bunched' 0/253/255 stops and a=d=0 (pure 90deg skew) are genuine authored data, not a parse bug.

(2) SWF ENCODE (shapes.ts + morphshape.ts): BUG. The explicit-matrix path multiplied a/b/c/d by 80 (FLA_TO_SWF, on the false premise that a/b/c/d were 'px per +/-1 gradient unit'). For b=0.0244 that yields round(0.0244*80)=2 as a 16.16 int (~0.00003 float) -> gradient matrix collapsed to ~zero -> Ruffle drew a near-degenerate / non-smooth gradient. FIX: a/b/c/d are already SWF 16.16 float values, so convert with *65536 (b -> 1600); tx/ty stay *20 (px->twips). Verified: our published golden gradient MATRIX now == golden.swf exactly: scaleX/scaleY=0, skew0=0.0244140625, skew1=-0.0750732421875, translateX=1, translateY=120.

(3) STAGE RENDER (engine/renderer.ts): BUG. The canvas renderer ignored fill.matrix and derived the gradient axis from the path bbox + the model angle. Because halfLen used max(width,height)=123px (button is 123x45px), the gradient was stretched to 123px while the shape only spans 45px tall -> only the middle ~0.36..0.68 band of the cyan->blue ramp was visible, which (with stops bunched at 0/253/255) read as a near-uniform mid-blue = looked SOLID. FIX: when fill.matrix is present, compute the gradient endpoints by transforming the SWF gradient-space x-axis endpoints (+/-16384 twips) through the matrix into local px (linear); for radial, center=translate, radius=|gradient x-axis|. Falls back to angle/bbox auto-fit when no matrix (authoring-UI gradients). New span: y -14..26px (the authored 40px) -> full smooth cyan->blue.

EVIDENCE:
- node tools/golden-parity.mjs -> EXIT 0 (only FAIL is TEXT PARITY, expected/task1195). golden-v2 EXIT 0. PLACEMENTS 4/4, TAG INVENTORY pass.
- swf-dump of our published golden gradient == golden.swf gradient (matrix + stops identical).
- e2e golden-fla-oracle (Ruffle): PASS, 5765 colored px (golden ref 5673; ~1.6% delta) - smooth cyan->blue button face. Screenshot /tmp/grad-ours.png vs /tmp/grad-golden.png match.
- Stage screenshot bridge (screenshotStage on golden.fla): smooth cyan->blue gradient (was solid). /tmp/grad-stage.png.
- Unit: packages/swf gradient tests 42/42 pass (gradientmatrix/gradient-fill/gradient-spread/morphshape-gradient-fill). Full swf suite 1317 pass / core suite 5132 pass (with concurrent agents' unrelated fonts.ts[1195]/buttons.test[1196] WIP stashed).

SCOPE: packages/swf/src/shapes.ts, packages/swf/src/morphshape.ts, packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts, packages/swf/src/__tests__/gradientmatrix.test.ts. flash8-binary.ts unchanged (already correct).
